title: Early deliberate mummification in Egypt
summary: Egyptians begin deliberately preserving the dead with linen wrappings and resin-based embalming oils; a Turin mummy about 5,600 years old shows the practice. Older mummies are known from Chile and Southeast Asia.
why: Start of a practice central to Egyptian religion for millennia.

notes.problem: Title drops the source's qualifier ('First evidence of mummification in Egypt', Timeline of prehistory, 3500 BC). Mummy article: Chinchorro child mummy c. 5050 BC and smoke-dried mummies ~10,000 BC are older.
